lines.name: Proof Ball
lines.intro: A known dimension you can hold beside the fish. Clips to a keyring, floats, and reads from a single frame.

skus.name: Proof Ball — Orange {dim}
skus.subtitle: Orange · {dim}
skus.description: The original reference sphere. Drops in the net, measures anything.
skus.shopDescription: The original, designed to be held next to a catch in hero shots. It also clips to a keyring, floats if you drop it, and pairs to your account with one tap — the simplest way to get verified measurements on everyday fish.
